name: clone-tabnews
description: Um clone do projeto tabnews para estudos

scripts.dev: npm run setup-docker-postgres && npm run migration:up && next dev
scripts.test: npm run services:up && concurrently --names next,jest --hide next --kill-others --success command-jest "next dev" "jest --runInBand --verbose"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run services:up && concurrently --names next,jest --hide next --kill-others --success command-jest "next dev" "jest --runInBand --coverage --verbose"
scripts.setup-docker-postgres: npm run services:up && npm run wait-for-postgres
